hazards.name: NY / CT parkways (Hutch, Saw Mill, Taconic, Southern & Northern State, Merritt…)
hazards.place: NYC metro, Long Island, Westchester, SW Connecticut
hazards.advice: Commercial vehicles are banned on these parkways and the overpasses are low. Truckers report NY-area posted clearances can be off by about a foot.

sources.title: NYC DOT: Know your height
CT Mirror: The Merritt Parkway is not for trucks
FreightWaves: parkway overpass strikes near New York

hazards.name: Eisenhower–Johnson Tunnel, I-70
hazards.advice: Hazmat loads are not allowed in the tunnel: use Loveland Pass (US 6). If Loveland is closed, CDOT escorts hazmat through, usually at the top of the hour. Approach grades are about 7%.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Eisenhower Tunnel
CDOT: Eisenhower Tunnel metering

hazards.name: I-70 mountain corridor (Eisenhower Tunnel, Vail & Loveland Passes)
hazards.advice: Colorado runs some of the strictest commercial chain laws; heavy storms and 60+ mph gusts. Carry chains Sept–May and check CDOT/COtrip before the climb.

hazards.name: Monteagle grade, I-24
hazards.advice: Eastbound: about 6% for ~4 mi (max 6.9%). Truck limit 45 mph, inspection station at the top, two runaway ramps below. Gear down before the crest.

hazards.name: Cabbage Hill (Emigrant Hill), I-84
hazards.advice: ~7-mile downgrade with a double hairpin; snow, fog and black ice. Escape ramps around mileposts 220–221.
